decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00am to 6.00pm on Mondays to Friday and 8.00am  to 1.00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that the application for the construction of a two storey side and single storey rear extension will not have any detrimental impacts on the appearance of the residential dwelling, the character of the street scene or the amenity of the adjoining residential properties. The proposal is therefore compliant with the provisions of Policy ENV B.1.1 - New development, Policy H.6.4 - Extensions and Alterations and Policy T.1.4 - Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and Sections 1.0 - Single Storey Rear Extensions and Conservatories and 4.0 - Two Storey Side and First Floor Extensions of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and  two storey side extension to dwellinghouse.
